players.product: X-ray metrology for 3D transistor & advanced-packaging process control (with Onto AI Diffract)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (January - June 2026) results: revenue JPY 39,565 million, down 2.9% (JPY 40,756 million a year earlier); operating income JPY 2,579 million, down 54.9%; interim profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 1,628 million, down 56.9%; R&D expenses JPY 3,886 million. Management states revenue and operating income fell year on year but semiconductor process control equipment exceeded its expectations, the pipeline for growth from Q3 onward is progressing well and the current order outlook is up significantly year on year. It says the semiconductor market stayed firm, led by memory and logic, on AI infrastructure and cloud data-center investment, and the Middle East situation has had only a minor impact so far, though it is preparing for cost increases and securing inventory.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue JPY 39,565 million (-2.9%); operating income JPY 2,579 million (-54.9%)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 semiconductor process control equipment revenue JPY 12,791 million, up 18.2% (JPY 10,824 million a year earlier), which management attributes to capturing rising memory and logic demand and to new-product projects progressing well; by destination US JPY 4,008 million (JPY 2,754 million), Asia JPY 6,034 million (JPY 4,701 million), Japan JPY 2,329 million, Europe JPY 418 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Semiconductor process control equipment JPY 12,791 million (+18.2%)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 other product categories: multi-purpose analytical instruments JPY 15,081 million, down 17.1%, on continued Trump-administration policy effects in the US and a weaker market from Middle East-driven energy price swings, though management says demand from semiconductor and electronic-component customers is rising and orders for Q3 onward are increasing. Parts and services JPY 11,692 million, down 0.5%, roughly flat: EUV multilayer mirror sales stayed weak while services and other analytical instruments and parts grew.
quarterly_data.figure: Multi-purpose analytical instruments JPY 15,081 million (-17.1%); parts and services JPY 11,692 million (-0.5%)

quarterly_data.signal: Capital and business alliance agreement with Onto Innovation signed April 21, 2026, effective on Onto's purchase of 61,123,436 Rigaku shares (26.99% of shares outstanding excluding treasury shares) from Atom Investment, L.P., which completed August 10, 2026. The report states the two companies began joint development in May 2025 of a hybrid metrology solution combining Rigaku's CD-SAXS with Onto Innovation's analysis software; the alliance widens that collaboration to joint development of hybrid metrology solutions for next-generation semiconductors (AI, advanced logic, advanced memory, advanced packaging). Rigaku states the alliance should accelerate its full-scale entry into back-end (packaging) processes, strengthen its software and AI-based solution capability and improve customer support through Onto's resources.
quarterly_data.figure: Onto Innovation holds 26.99%; CD-SAXS + Onto software joint development since May 2025
